title: Deterministic Atomic Recovery Admission V1
mission: Add a deterministic create-if-absent recovery admission pin so all workers trying to recover the same stale predecessor contend on one stable path before any randomized recovery claim/run is created. Preserve recovery claims/runs/returns as append-only evidence. A loser must PARK/RELOAD; a later recovery generation must derive a new admission identity only from a newly-stale predecessor after terminal/eligibility evidence is re-fetched. Reuse the existing lease/retry primitives rather than creating a second stale policy.

observed_incident.page_thread_bridge: At least five distinct recovery-claim files appeared for O-SWARM-PAGE-THREAD-BRIDGE-V1 during the 09:51-09:55 ART collision window.
observed_incident.kernel: A separate kernel recovery run durably recorded multiple competing recovery claims/runs in the same collision window and reconciled them post hoc, showing the failure is systemic rather than lane-specific.
observed_incident.existing_primitive_limit: O-SWARM-LEASE-RETRY-BUILD-V1 correctly defines active-overlap => PARK, but its RETURN states that active-overlap evidence is caller-supplied and the scanner does not atomically persist admission.

candidate_design.principle: Random recovery_attempt_id may identify evidence after admission, but it must not be the exclusivity key.
candidate_design.admission_identity: Deterministically derive one key from opportunity_id + exact previous_run + binding recovery-policy generation/version. All contenders for that stale predecessor attempt CREATE the same admission path.
candidate_design.winner_flow: atomic create succeeds -> re-fetch eligibility/CAS -> create append-only randomized recovery claim + fresh STARTED run referencing admission pin
candidate_design.loser_flow: create collision -> read winner/active state -> PARK/RELOAD; never create a parallel recovery claim for the same predecessor
candidate_design.next_generation: Only a later stale predecessor/run produces a new deterministic admission key after terminal/no-return/eligibility evidence is re-derived.
candidate_design.late_return_rule: A late original or recovery RETURN remains candidate evidence and forces reconciliation; admission never promotes Current/Human Accepted/Served.

unblock_value.reason: The broad /wc canary is currently producing concurrent stale recoveries; without atomic admission, recovery itself becomes a duplication/collision amplifier at exactly the load level the canary is meant to test.

compounding_value.reason: One deterministic admission primitive can protect every opportunity/root/surface and lets later allocator/metabolism automation invoke recovery without human arbitration.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Prevents the human/guide from having to inspect and reconcile duplicate recovery attempts created by identical workers.

must_fail_if: two workers with the same opportunity_id and previous_run can both obtain active recovery admission
random recovery_attempt_id remains the exclusivity key
a loser can create a recovery claim/run after losing admission without a new predecessor generation
terminal/RETURN evidence is ignored when deriving a later generation
recovery admission mutates or erases original claim/run/return history
admission implies promotion to Current, Human Accepted or Served
proof_required: concurrency test with many contenders for one stale predecessor yielding exactly one winner
second-generation test proving a newly-stale recovery predecessor can obtain one new admission without reopening the old generation
late-return race test preserving both evidence branches and requiring reconciliation
live /wc canary receipt showing duplicate recovery claims no longer fan out for a shared stale predecessor

acceptance_details: same opportunity + same exact previous_run deterministically maps to one create-if-absent admission path
under concurrent contenders exactly one active recovery winner exists for that predecessor generation
winner recovery claim/run references the admission pin; losers durably PARK/RELOAD or simply lose the atomic create without parallel mutation
existing lease/retry 20/30-minute policy and CAS/refetch rules remain authoritative and are reused
append-only original/recovery evidence and late-return reconciliation are preserved
an independent critic verifies the race fix before it can contribute to /w readiness
